seo.title: MESME | Diamond Bear Car Fragrance Jewellery
seo.description: Discover the MESME Diamond Bear, car fragrance jewellery in Gold and Black editions. Explore the craftsmanship, Origin No. 1 and private consultation.

hero.copy: A signature scent carried in gold and diamonds, made for the journey.
